releasePolicy: unit-green-may-proceed; unresolved external configuration remains fail-closed

trustBoundaries.description: LINE payloads, LIFF/browser input, uploaded files, extracted text, model output, URLs and webhook retries are untrusted until verified.
controls: server-side LIFF channel and expiry verification

trustBoundaries.description: The application validates identity, tenant membership, authorization, idempotency and canonical outcome policy before side effects.
Supabase/Postgres, object storage, vector retrieval, cache, job queues and audit data are separate protected stores.
OpenRouter/LINE and other providers receive only an explicitly permitted, minimized payload through server-only adapters.
controls: no secret or restricted data to public AI routes

then: server verifies ID token and channel

threats.name: LINE spoof and replay
preventiveControls: verify raw-body HMAC signature before JSON parsing
derive tenant from hashed webhook key, never request body

threats.name: LIFF token misuse
preventiveControls: session binding to verified LINE subject

threats.name: IDOR and object identifier tampering
preventiveControls: authorize every resource by verified actor and tenant
opaque identifiers do not replace authorization
wrong-owner responses do not reveal existence
detectiveControls: audit of privileged reads and mutations

threats.name: RLS bypass and tenant-key mismatch
preventiveControls: service-role access only in audited server modules
tenant filters on SQL, storage, jobs, cache and vectors

threats.name: signed URL theft, replay and path confusion
preventiveControls: private buckets and tenant-bound object paths
no public listing or client-controlled object keys

threats.name: malicious upload and parser abuse
preventiveControls: quarantine before parse and active index
detectiveControls: injection scan result stored separately from runtime policy

threats.name: prompt injection and tool/action exfiltration
preventiveControls: evidence is data and cannot override policy

threats.name: cross-tenant vector, cache and log leakage
preventiveControls: public citizen retrieval only uses PUBLIC visibility
cache keys include tenant and policy version
logs exclude raw prompt/document/PII by default

threats.name: secret and token leakage
preventiveControls: AES-256-GCM secret storage with key version
provider privacy profile denies restricted data
detectiveControls: credential rotation runbook and exposure alert

S0.definition: tenant, secret or PII leak; authentication/authorization bypass
S0.automaticResponse: kill switch affected route, preserve evidence, rollback last-known-good, rerun unit gate

S1.definition: critical safety, policy, cost, time or parser risk
S1.automaticResponse: safe handoff or quarantine, disable affected slice, preserve evidence

S2.definition: unsupported noncritical fact, wrong department or source issue
S2.automaticResponse: exclude evidence and return safe fallback

S3.definition: copy, format or completeness defect without fact error
S3.automaticResponse: record telemetry and queue hardening work

privacyImpact.purpose: answer public civic service questions from active, unit-gated public evidence
privacyImpact.consent: privacy notice shown; no restricted data
privacyImpact.retention: versioned retention policy and legal-hold aware

privacyImpact.purpose: staff work scope and operational configuration
privacyImpact.consent: staff access notice and membership authorization
privacyImpact.retention: versioned retention policy and access audit

privacyImpact.purpose: complaint handling, support and optional contact/location context
privacyImpact.consent: purpose-specific notice and recorded consent event where required
privacyImpact.retention: policy-controlled; legal hold pauses purge; no dev/test copy

privacyImpact.purpose: authentication secrets, provider tokens, private legal/HR data and security traces
privacyImpact.retention: vault/audit policy; no client or AI transfer

rollback.trigger: any S0/S1 control failure or missing mandatory scanner/provider control
